name: Author and Publish Blog Posts From Google Sheets
description: Enables authoring blog posts in Google Sheets and automatically publishing them to a content management system, simplifying content creation and publishing.

source.path: Google_Drive_and_Google_Sheets/Author and Publish Blog Posts From Google Sheets.json

blockers.detail: yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND waits for the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1) to be published

setup: "CreatePost": yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND comes from the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1), which is not published yet; this step fails until it ships, then the template promotes on the next catalog refresh.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate author-and-publish-blog-posts-from-google-sheets.

hints: "CreatePost" sends its raw body with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s).
"SaveBackToSheet" mapped columns automatically; here each item's fields are appended in their own order, so keep them in the same order as the sheet's header row.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Author Blog-Post
Using OpenRouter to make model fully configurable for each authoring stage

## Publish Blog-Post
Use a generic XMLHttpRequest with subsequent response handling, since the Wordpress node did not work at all.

## Post-process Data
Normalize and re-merge output data structure.

## Post-process Data
Extract post id or error message from response.
